facts.fact: OGP Tunisie reports a workshop on 26 March 2026, held with the PAGOF programme, to present and discuss the final draft of the National Strategy for the Governance, Opening and Valorisation of Public Data, under government decree 2021-3; no adoption is stated.
facts.system: National Strategy for the Governance, Opening and Valorisation of Public Data

note: Scope is public-data governance and opening, so the parent may judge it nearer open data than a whole-government data policy; no body or rule is stated.
